method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: An orthographic grille on a mid-tone field reads as an HVAC register; the ember stretch muddy brown.
notes.fix: A low raking key, caliche grain falling to black outside a pool, the open stretch at true dusk_ember with visible depth.

notes.problem: A grey grating on mottled grey reads as a floor vent; the open stretch a flat brown panel; no true black, no bright edge.
notes.fix: Cut the open stretch three times deeper with ember walls under a low rake, or reshoot it in perspective at a 1.5 m eye in the pool.

notes.problem: Grey grating on mottled charcoal reads as a floor vent; the open stretch maroon rather than ember.
notes.fix: Set the trench in lit caliche raked low from the left, the open stretch at the true ember value, a tighter crop on the grating's end.

notes.problem: A mannequin beside a broadside pack reading as a wooden fence in a void.
notes.fix: A three-quarter view on the end face, the pack and worker seated in the caliche pool with contact shadows, the worker cropped at the knee.

notes.problem: A square-on pack reads as a slat crate, cropped so the count is never whole; the worker a mannequin.
notes.fix: A three-quarter view pulled back to show the whole end face and length, raked from the low left key; the worker a rim-lit silhouette.

notes.problem: The pack reads as a corrugated container wall cropped off the left edge; a mannequin worker; a dead black band under the dek.
notes.fix: Turn the pack three-quarter with the whole end face in frame, raise it into the band, the worker smaller and rim-lit on the shadow side.

notes.problem: A mannequin at a flat table in an empty bay; the stack a beige block; the lamp's pool on the floor.
notes.fix: Lower and closer so the lit stack and table edge own the lower half, the figure cropped at the shoulders, the pool on the paper.

notes.problem: A mannequin, one block of paper, a mid-tone horizon band and a girt through a dek line.
notes.fix: Lower the camera so the girt drops below the dek, light the figure only from the work light, crop to table, paper and lamp pool.

notes.problem: A mannequin behind a table; a column and braces through the dek.
notes.fix: Pull the camera right and lower so the column clears the type; the figure in profile over the table under the raking work light.

notes.problem: Four packs dead-on at one depth on black read as a bar chart.
notes.fix: A lower camera and a harder rake from the left, the dunnage and caliche pool running toward the camera, one depth kept.

notes.problem: A frontal orthographic copper bar chart with no seam and a dead black bottom third.
notes.fix: Rotate the row about 20 degrees, drop the eye, let the casts run across lit caliche, bring the seam in.

notes.problem: Front-lit packs read as a bar chart over a black void with no ground or casts.
notes.fix: Camera at dunnage height, the row in the middle third lit from the left with casts across lit caliche.
